computer-use-linux.description: Primary actuation — Wayland-native click/type/scroll with semantic selectors (@agent-sh/computer-use-linux).

shadow-vision.description: Primary perception — local OCR + VLM UI analysis via Ollama (no screenshot leaves host).

ghostdesk.description: Isolated execution — full Linux desktop in Docker for risky GUI automation (Streamable HTTP loopback only).

eye2byte.description: Verification layer — post-action screenshot diff + confidence scoring.

uacc.description: Fallback actuator — 68 tools, vision-optional, self-healing retries.

deskwright.description: Headless desktop — dedicated virtual monitor for isolated background sessions.

n8n.description: Opt-in cloud workflow bridge — external SaaS orchestration (NEVER enabled by default; gated behind web_comms.enabled=true).

kwin-mcp.description: Isolated KDE Plasma 6 Wayland virtual KWin session (kwin_wayland --virtual + private EIS + AT-SPI2).

linux-system-mcp.description: Linux system bridge — GUI dialogs, notifications, timeout shell, GUI sudo, and mid-execution ask_user confirmation.

vadgr-computer-use.description: Accessibility-first CPU-friendly Linux fallback (UIA/AT-SPI/AX across GNOME, KDE, wlroots, X11, Wayland).

swadb-memory.description: Built-in sovereign SQLite demand-constructed memory MCP server (swadb/Engrama: 10 typed edges, 9-stage retrieval, 9 memory tools).

git.description: Official open-source MCP Git server (local repo status, diffs, commits, zero cloud API).

sqlite.description: Open-source local SQLite MCP server for querying and analyzing local .db files.

playwright.description: Official open-source Playwright MCP server for reliable browser automation & web form workflows.

context7.description: Open-source Context7 MCP server for live, up-to-date programming library & framework docs.

time.description: Official open-source MCP Time & Timezone conversion server.

github.description: Official GitHub MCP connector (issues, pull requests, repositories — set GITHUB_TOKEN in ~/.config/celina/env).

linear.description: Linear MCP connector for issue & project tracking (set LINEAR_API_KEY in ~/.config/celina/env).

notion.description: Notion MCP connector for notes & workspace pages (set NOTION_TOKEN in ~/.config/celina/env).
